basics.name: Ulises Alejandro MORA QUINTANA
basics.label: Full Stack Developer / Cloud Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Full Stack Developer (+5 years) & Cloud Architect with a versatile mastery of the TypeScript ecosystem (NestJS, Next.js, React, Angular) alongside Enterprise .NET & Python. I specialize in building scalable architectures that integrate AI/LLM pipelines and Web3/Blockchain technologies. Uniquely positioning myself at the intersection of tech and business, I leverage my specialized training in Cybersecurity and Entrepreneurship to deliver 'Secure by Design' solutions that drive tangible business value. Proven track record navigating diverse dynamics, from agile startups to corporate enterprise environments, and experience working in it consulting companies.

work.name: Autocom (Mexico - Remote)
work.summary: ● Architected high-availability backend solutions using ASP.NET Core, serving as the backbone for critical transactional systems. ● Implemented AWS API Gateway to manage traffic and secured endpoints for microservices deployed on AWS Fargate (ECS) using Docker containers. ● Established asynchronous communication layers using AWS SQS and SNS to decouple services and ensure data reliability. ● Integrated Python scripts and Lambdas to automate cloud infrastructure and process background data, reducing operational manual loads by 40%. ● Developed and maintained internal dashboard frontends using React and Angular. ● Orchestrated a polyglot persistence layer (SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis) and established CI/CD pipelines.
highlights: Modernized backend with ECS Fargate/Docker and introduced Python automations for cloud efficiency.

work.name: GPT4SALES (Mexico, USA Remote) Freelance Project
work.summary: ● Designed a scalable microservices architecture implementing Apollo Federation 2 with NestJS and GraphQL as the unified API Gateway. ● Engineered a **multi-layered LLM pipeline** using Python (LangChain) that processes user inputs through distinct stages: **initial intent detection**, context filtering, and routing to specialized flows, optimizing accuracy and token usage. ● Integrated the Meta API (WhatsApp Business) to orchestrate omnichannel chatbots. ● Implemented Stripe for subscription management. ● Orchestrated infrastructure with Terraform/Docker on AWS ECS Fargate/S3. ● Integrated RabbitMQ for event-driven communication and Redis for caching. ● CSS, SASS, SCSS, MATERIAL UI, NEXTJS, MATERIAL UI
highlights: Architected a multi-stage LLM ecosystem with NestJS/GraphQL that intelligently filters intents for complex AI workflows.

highlights: Optimized the Django backend for performance and successfully integrated 3D visualization features.
